_published_faq.name: How do I add Telgani to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Telgani to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.telgani.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Telgani MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Telgani scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Telgani MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Telgani provides these MCP tools: find_offers.
Telgani does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Telgani is developed by Telgani Advanced company for Communication and Information Technology. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
